eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 5:38 PM on JUL 31, 2023 Effective until 3:38 AM AUG 1, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Riverside County Sheriff's Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Riverside County Sheriff's Department is looking for a hispanic male;Salomon Rojas Moreno, 80 years old, 5 foot 3 inches, 134 pounds, gray hair with brown eyes. Salomon was last seen wearing a light blue shirt, dark gray pants, black open-end shoes. Salomon was last seen on 07/26/2023 at 8 pm traveling eastbound on Interstate 8 in the area of mile post 83 in Sentinel, Arizona. Salomon was last seen driving a brown 2003 Nissan Murano, California license plate number 7 G Z C 4 4 2. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
